blocks.text:
The next four days have no compulsory excursions.

The hotel is right on the beachfront, so you can walk straight to the sea in the morning and easily return to your room during the day.

At low tide, the sea retreats, leaving shallow natural pools between the reefs. Later, the water rises again and covers the rocks.

You can swim at Muro Alto, walk along the shore or relax by the pool.

For a more active day, diving and buggy trips along the coast are available.

After Rio, Iguaçu and the Amazon, these four days give you time without further flights or transfers.
